section.title: 对话 2
section.preview: W: Hi, John. Why haven't you answered my text messages lately?

lines.text: W: Hi, John. Why haven't you answered my text messages lately?
M: Oh, I didn't know you had sent any.
I turned off my phone almost a week ago and haven't turned it back on since then.
W: Why would you do something like that when our phones make our lives so much more convenient?
M: Well, I downloaded an app that recorded how much time I spent on my phone, and I was shocked to realize I was using my phone an average of eight hours a day,
And on my worst day, I used it for 12 hours.
W: Were you addicted to mobile phone games?
I had a friend who was, and he sometimes played them all day and into the night.
M: No, my problem was I was spending too much time on social media, messaging friends and commenting on other people's posts.
W: I do all of that too, as well as shopping online and paying for everything with my phone.
That is really why I don't see how anyone could live without a mobile phone.
How do you buy things or communicate with your friends?
M: Since I stopped using my phone, I go to physical stores and pay in cash.
I've actually met friends for meals at cafés and restaurants.
But my friends and family don't live in this city, so we can't see each other often, and I don't have any choice but to chat with them online.
